text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Ah! The croquettes!
Trainer, this is terrible! The croquettes are gone!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to bring home some of those crispy, fluffy croquettes as a souvenir...
Do you think we'll make it in time?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Really? In that case...
I'll just take enough to eat on the plane♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Excuse me, croquettes, please—!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highness! Please hurry, or you'll miss your ride...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The day for Fine Motion to return to her home country had finally arrived.
Yet, she carried on just as usual...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
No problem at all!
I've already shipped my luggage, so all that's left is to run—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you can't keep up, right, Trainer?
...Alright, once I get my croquette, I'll hurry back!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
The minced meat cutlets will be ready soon too...
Care for one fresh out of the fryer?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'll gladly have some, of course♪

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text: Your Highneeess~!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
You made it in time!
Thank goodness♪
choice_data_list: I ended up running after all...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, maybe that was a bit selfish of me?
I just wanted to keep running for as long as possible!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
"I will go take care of the paperwork.
Trainer, may I leave Her Highness in your care?"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, it seems they were being considerate of us.
...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...Still,
I might not have anything to talk about."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've already spent enough precious time with you.
Talking, running... sharing my feelings.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"I can't put it into words
any more than this."

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
Why? Just speak freely
like you always do.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Groove-san!
Did you come to see me off?

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: I'm the representative. Truth be told, I planned to bring one more person... but I was flatly turned down with an 'I'm busy.'

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Fufu.
You usually give in pretty easily, though.

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text: Beats me. But... ah, what a shame. Looks like we won't have time to chat at our leisure anymore.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Uh—

text_block_list.name: Fans
text_block_list.text: Fiiine!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It was a truly breathtaking sight.
A great multitude of fans had gathered
to see Fine Motion off.

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
"I'll never, ever
forget your running!"

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Show us how you're doing over there from time to time!
No matter what, we'll always be cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Air Groove
text_block_list.text:
...I'm glad, Fine.
This is all a legacy you left behind.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
choice_data_list: Thank you for moving me, Fine

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Likewise.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Thank you, Trainer...
You have done well.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so—Fine Motion returned to her homeland,
taking the cheers of the massive crowd as her souvenir.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, one day after
some time had passed...

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
—Hmph, so that's the move you made, huh...?
Well, it's still within the margin of error.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What're you lookin' at?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Ain't got no obligation to answer ya.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Air Shakur declared her retirement
at the Arima Kinen. But...
I don't know if she ever actually submitted the paperwork after that.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: "...Your former trainee is already making a huge splash overseas, huh."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Shortly after Fine Motion returned to her home country,
news reports suggested she was engaged in the "mission"
she had always spoken of.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, like she'd come. 
That's just the kind of person she is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Haaah? Like hell it is.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
That goes for you, doesn't it?
'Lonely' is written all over your face, ya know?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ...Show a little discretion, will you?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: ..................Well, I appreciate the thought—

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
—Huh?
Since when did you two get so close?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...!?
Why... you little...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text: Wha—why...!

text_block_list.name: Bodyguard Captain
text_block_list.text:
Your Highness, please wait...!
The re-enrollment procedures aren't finished yet!
choice_data_list: Returning to school?! What does that mean?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ahem, surprise!
Believe it or not, I'm coming back to this academy!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah!?
What happened to that "mission" of yours!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
It's for that exact mission!
I've been appointed as the new 'Japan Goodwill Ambassador'♪

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"My job is to serve as a bridge between Japan and Ireland!
Recognizing my past track record, they decided I was the right fit for the role."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"That is why I transferred back to Tracen Academy
to fulfill my mission here in Japan."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I get to run in the Twinkle Series again!
Together with everyone...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
...Hahah!
Hahahahaha...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
I see...!
So the ending actually changed...!

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"Then there's no point in retiring. Change of plans.
...This time, I'm gonna blow everyone's minds!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Huh, leaving already?
Don't you need my data?

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
Hah, like hell I would. 
Your current data isn't worth squat.

text_block_list.name: Air Shakur
text_block_list.text:
"If you really wanna run with me that badly—
then get up 'here', dummy."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"...And that's why.
I came right back♪"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
After giving me such a grand farewell...
even I feel pretty embarrassed coming back, you know?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: “None of that mattered, though... I wanted to run, I wanted to run so badly... I just couldn't help myself!”

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
To become the bridge connecting Japan and Ireland—
I want to fulfill that new mission together with you!
That's why...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Would you... be my Trainer
once more?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...!
Thank you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: I'm home, Trainer♪
